title: Oulipoly Tool Mediation v1 Extension
description: Host-selected provider/v1 extension by which a host supplies its Bash tool policy and its Bash requester and ingress to a provider as launch-environment data. Selected by host.env.OULIPOLY_HOST_TOOL_MEDIATION_V1=1 in describe and advertised as capabilities.tool_mediation_v1. The host places one ToolMediation object, JSON-encoded, in the launch environment variable OULIPOLY_TOOL_MEDIATION_V1 (policy.evaluate launch.env, and so the evaluated and resident template env). A provider that reads it either makes its native agent's only command tool the mediated bash tool under exactly this policy or refuses; it never ignores it.

BashPolicy.description: allow: only these whole command strings run, matched exactly; anything else is refused by the mediated tool and nothing runs. authority trusted-task: any command, as the host's once-per-task authority. Exactly one form.

requester.description: Absolute path of the host's Bash requester. It implements the agent-bash root v1 requester surface: `run --delivery sync|async -- ARGV...`, `native-output IDENTITY --offset N --length N` and `native-accept IDENTITY`, each writing one JSON result object (result_surface agent-bash-root-v1 or agent-bash-root-v1-output) and reaching only the ingress named by ingress_env.

ingress_env.description: Name of the environment variable through which the host names the root's Bash ingress to the serving process and its descendants. It is not part of this object's value; it must be present in the environment of the process that serves a turn, or the turn is refused before any native effect.

EffectiveMediation.description: Value of the oulipoly.tool_mediation/v1 policy.evaluate marker: what the provider will configure natively for this policy. native_tools are the provider's native tool names the agent is offered; tool is the mediated bash tool's native name. Construction, not a certificate that the native CLI honours it.
